data.gender_notes: Akira is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'akr' meaning 'radiant' and 'ira' meaning 'shining'. It is a powerful name that evokes images of light, courage and strength. The name Akira carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Akira usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Akira is a name that represents the divine light within us. It is a name that inspires courage and strength, and reminds us of our inner power and radiance.
data.etymology: Akira belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akira total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
